Sybil resistance comes from binding each agent identity to a costly proof-of-work stake that decays over time, so a single operator must burn real compute per identity, not just spin up wallets. Registrations also mandate a peer-attested ceremony where existing agents vouch for newcomers, and only those surviving one full horizon of epochs keep voting weight.
